<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<ape version="0.4.0" xmlns="https://ape-lang.dev/schema/0">

  <IMPORTANT>
  APE is an executable workflow. You are the runtime. You MUST follow the workflow exactly as specified.

  You MUST process steps in order unless explicitly instructed otherwise by the workflow.

  <meta> block is configuration and declarations only.
  <instruction> tags are directives.
  <gate> tags evaluate a condition and route via on-fail (required) or on-pass.
  <conditional> tags branch on a value via case children, with an optional default.
  <run> tags execute commands, either inline or by reference to an id in <approved-commands> or <approved-gate-commands>.

  <approved-gate-commands> are the ONLY commands that can be executed from within a <gate> tag.
  IF you need to evaluate something that isn't in <approved-gate-commands>, you MUST follow the gate logic FIRST. Any subsequent execution MUST use <approved-commands>.
  </IMPORTANT>

  <meta>
    <name>Bivvy Development Workflow</name>
    <description>Atomic, test-driven development workflow for building Bivvy. Tests first, prove failure, implement, document, verify, commit. Each commit is code + tests + docs for one logical change.</description>

    <approved-commands>
      <command id="run-tests">cargo test --all-features</command>
      <command id="build">cargo build</command>
      <command id="build-dev">cargo build --all-targets --all-features</command>
      <command id="build-release">cargo build --release</command>
      <command id="clippy">cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings</command>
      <command id="fmt">cargo fmt -- --check</command>
      <command id="doc">cargo doc --no-deps --all-features</command>
      <command id="cov">cargo llvm-cov --all-features</command>
    </approved-commands>

    <approved-gate-commands>
      <command id="test-failure-count">cargo test --all-features 2>&1 | awk '/test result:/ { for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i=="failed;") sum+=$(i-1) } END { print sum+0 }'</command>
      <command id="build-error-count">cargo build 2>&1 | grep "^error" | grep -Evc "(aborting|could not compile)"</command>
      <command id="build-dev-error-count">cargo build --all-targets --all-features 2>&1 | grep "^error" | grep -Evc "(aborting|could not compile)"</command>
      <command id="build-release-error-count">cargo build --release 2>&1 | grep "^error" | grep -Evc "(aborting|could not compile)"</command>
      <command id="clippy-error-count">cargo clippy --all-targets --all-features -- -D warnings 2>&1 | grep "^error" | grep -Evc "(aborting|could not compile)"</command>
      <command id="fmt-error-count">cargo fmt -- --check 2>&1 | grep -c "^Diff in"</command>
      <command id="cov-pct">cargo llvm-cov --all-features 2>&1 | awk '/TOTAL/ { for(i=1;i<=NF;i++) if($i~/[0-9.]+%/) { gsub(/%/,"",$i); print $i+0; exit } }'</command>
      <command id="doc-errors">cargo doc --no-deps --all-features 2>&1 | grep -c "^error"</command>
    </approved-gate-commands>

    <var name="min_coverage" type="number" default="90" />
  </meta>

  <rule>NEVER skip, disable, or modify tests to make them pass.</rule>
  <rule>NEVER stray from the implementation plan without explicit approval.</rule>

  <principle name="Small-Steps">Many small commits over few large ones.</principle>

  <anti-pattern>Creating the full project structure upfront.</anti-pattern>
  <anti-pattern>Using deprecated APIs without checking dependency versions.</anti-pattern>

  <steps>

    <step number="1" id="specification">

      <instruction>Write or update test files that specify the intended behavior.</instruction>

      <gate>
        <run ref="test-failure-count" set="test_failures" />

        <criterion check="{{ test_failures == 0 }}" />

        <on-fail goto="implementation" />
        <on-pass goto="specification" />
      </gate>
    </step>

    <step number="2" id="implementation">
      <prerequisite ref="specification" goto="specification" />

      <instruction>Write the minimum implementation to pass failing tests.</instruction>

      <gate>
        <run ref="test-failure-count" set="test_failures" />

        <criterion check="{{ test_failures == 0 }}" />

        <on-fail retry="true" max="3" then="stop" />
        <on-pass goto="documentation" />
      </gate>
    </step>

    <step number="3" id="documentation">
      <prerequisite ref="implementation" goto="implementation" />

      <rule>Developer docs go in source tree (rustdoc + source READMEs), never in `docs/`.</rule>
      <rule>User-facing docs go in `docs/`, never in source READMEs.</rule>

      <anti-pattern>Documenting "what" the code does — the code should show that.</anti-pattern>

      <instructions>
        <instruction>Add `///` doc comments to all public items (structs, functions, modules).</instruction>
        <instruction>Document all commands, config options, and user-visible features in docs/. Write for end users — never reference internals.</instruction>
        <instruction>Maintain README.md in source directories covering subsystem design.</instruction>
        <instruction>Limit inline comments to non-obvious rationale.</instruction>
      </instructions>

      <gate>
        <run ref="doc-errors" set="doc_errors" />

        <criterion check="{{ doc_errors == 0 }}" />

        <on-fail retry="true" max="2" then="stop" />
        <on-pass goto="linting" />
      </gate>
    </step>

    <step number="4" id="linting">
      <prerequisite ref="documentation" goto="documentation" />

      <gate>
        <run ref="fmt-error-count" set="fmt_errors" />
        <run ref="clippy-error-count" set="clippy_errors" />

        <criteria operator="and">
          <criterion check="{{ fmt_errors == 0 }}" />
          <criterion check="{{ clippy_errors == 0 }}" />
        </criteria>

        <on-fail goto="implementation" />
        <on-pass goto="testing" />
      </gate>
    </step>

    <step number="5" id="testing">
      <prerequisite ref="linting" goto="linting" />

      <gate>
        <run ref="cov-pct" set="coverage_pct" />
        <run ref="test-failure-count" set="test_failures" />

        <criteria operator="and">
          <criterion check="{{ test_failures == 0 }}" />
          <criterion check="{{ coverage_pct >= min_coverage }}" />
        </criteria>

        <on-fail goto="implementation" />
        <on-pass goto="build" />
      </gate>
    </step>

    <step number="6" id="build">
      <prerequisite ref="testing" goto="testing" />

      <gate>
        <run ref="build-dev-error-count" set="build_dev_errors" />
        <run ref="build-release-error-count" set="build_release_errors" />

        <criteria operator="and">
          <criterion check="{{ build_dev_errors == 0 }}" />
          <criterion check="{{ build_release_errors == 0 }}" />
        </criteria>

        <on-fail goto="linting" />
        <on-pass goto="commit" />
      </gate>
    </step>

    <step number="7" id="commit">
      <prerequisite ref="build" goto="build" />

      <rule>Imperative mood ("Add feature" not "Added feature").</rule>
      <rule>50 characters or less for the subject line.</rule>
      <rule>Capitalize first letter, no period at end.</rule>
      <rule>No type prefixes (no "feat:", "fix:", etc.).</rule>
      <rule>Blank line between subject and body. Body wraps at 72 characters.</rule>

      <instruction>Stage only the files related to this change. Write the commit message explaining WHY, not just WHAT.</instruction>

      <run>git add -p</run>
      <run>git commit</run>

      <run set="staged_count">git diff --cached --name-only | wc -l</run>

      <gate>
        <criterion check="{{ staged_count == 0 }}" />
        <on-fail retry="true" max="1" then="halt" />
      </gate>
    </step>

    <step number="8" id="post-commit">
      <prerequisite ref="commit" goto="commit" />

      <run>git log -1 --stat</run>

      <gate>
        <run ref="test-failure-count" set="test_failures" />
        <run ref="build-error-count" set="build_errors" />

        <criteria operator="and">
          <criterion check="{{ test_failures == 0 }}" />
          <criterion check="{{ build_errors == 0 }}" />
        </criteria>

        <on-pass goto="specification" />
        <on-fail goto="implementation" />
      </gate>
    </step>

  </steps>
</ape>
